claim_summary: The work evolves forecasting guidance from observed forecast traces, selects guidance using held-out temporal windows, and extends the learned policy into executable code that can use a TSFM tool.

claim_evidence.quote: Nothing is fine-tuned and no gradient exists: learning is the reflector turning observed forecasting mistakes into written advice, and selection keeping only advice that measurably works on windows it was not written from.
Per window, the code emits a proposal; a final LLM pass sees the window, guidance, code, proposal, and default TabPFN forecast, and makes the final call.

modules.name: Outcome-gated forecasting guidance evolution
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because reflection and selection optimize forecast output against per-window MASE; changing the task family would require redesigning the forecasting guidance and objective (counterfactual).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - forecast-specific output and error objective

evidence.quote: The reflector reads the minibatch’s full execution traces (raw histories, complete news context, forecast vs. realized paths, per-window MASE, rationales) and rewrites g freely; only ex-ante usability, generality, and the word cap bind.

Nothing is fine-tuned and no gradient exists: learning is the reflector turning observed forecasting mistakes into written advice, and selection keeping only advice that measurably works on windows it was not written from.

modules.name: Cutoff-postdating tiers with untouched monitor
modules.scope_reason: R3_2_GTS applies because tier admission depends on each model’s temporal knowledge cutoff and information availability; the same cutoff check on other time-indexed tasks would not require changing task logic (counterfactual).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:no - no forecast-output criterion in tier admission

evidence.quote: Cross-model experiments with Claude Opus 4.6 (Aug-2025 cutoff) use only origins after September 2025.

Optimization consumes data at three rates: a selection tier consulted every iteration (optimistic by construction); an untouched monitor never used for decisions, whose gap to selection measures overfitting; and final tiers set postdating every model’s cutoff touched exactly once for evaluation.

modules.name: Guidance-to-code compilation with TSFM tool
modules.scope_reason: R3_1_TSK applies because the compiled function and arbitration produce a task-specific forecast from series inputs; a different task family would require replacing its forecast logic and output contract (counterfactual).
rubric_path: R3_1_TSK:yes - forecast procedure and output contract

evidence.quote: compiles each candidate once into a deterministic forecast(window) function in an offline sandbox against a 12-window dev set
Per window, the code emits a proposal; a final LLM pass sees the window, guidance, code, proposal, and default TabPFN forecast, and makes the final call.

process_validity.quote: the harness independently re-runs the scorer on the final code, so implementation quality can neither block nor fake a candidate.

temporal_validity.quote: Cross-model experiments with Claude Opus 4.6 (Aug-2025 cutoff) use only origins after September 2025.

task_performance.quote: on the most recent, provably uncontaminated data, all four evolved cells beat all three zero-shot TSFMs overall (nominally best: Llama with the ∼900-word Gnum guidance, GM 0.776 vs. TabPFN-TS-3’s 0.898).
